SELECT id,
    job_id,
    status,
    COALESCE(proposal_payload ->> 'category'::text, title, 'proposal'::text) AS category,
    COALESCE((proposal_payload ->> 'priority'::text)::integer, priority) AS priority,
    COALESCE(proposal_payload ->> 'validation_notes'::text, proposal_payload ->> 'validationNotes'::text, ''::text) AS validation_notes,
        CASE
            WHEN status = 'approved'::text THEN updated_at
            ELSE NULL::timestamp with time zone
        END AS approved_at,
    COALESCE(proposal_payload ->> 'index_key'::text, proposal_payload ->> 'index'::text, 'ALL'::text) AS index_key,
    jsonb_build_object('proposal_id', COALESCE(proposal_payload ->> 'proposal_id'::text, id::text), 'status', status, 'index', COALESCE(proposal_payload ->> 'index'::text, proposal_payload ->> 'index_key'::text, 'ALL'::text), 'index_key', COALESCE(proposal_payload ->> 'index_key'::text, proposal_payload ->> 'index'::text, 'ALL'::text), 'category', COALESCE(proposal_payload ->> 'category'::text, title, 'proposal'::text), 'priority', COALESCE((proposal_payload ->> 'priority'::text)::integer, priority), 'hypothesis', COALESCE(proposal_payload ->> 'hypothesis'::text, ''::text), 'explanation', COALESCE(proposal_payload ->> 'explanation'::text, rationale, ''::text), 'conditions', COALESCE(proposal_payload -> 'conditions'::text, '{}'::jsonb), 'action', COALESCE(proposal_payload -> 'action'::text, '{}'::jsonb), 'evidence', COALESCE(proposal_payload -> 'evidence'::text, '{}'::jsonb))

SELECT date(poll_timestamp) AS capture_date,
    lane,
    count(*) AS total_snapshots,
    sum(jsonb_array_length(candidates)) AS total_candidates_captured
   FROM teaching_snapshots
  GROUP BY (date(poll_timestamp)), lane;

SELECT ml_action,
    count(*) AS n,
    round(avg(
        CASE
            WHEN won THEN 1.0
            ELSE 0.0
        END), 3) AS actual_wr,
    round(avg(p_final::numeric), 3) AS avg_p_predicted,
    round(avg(p_gbt::numeric), 3) AS avg_p_gbt,
    round(avg(p_nn::numeric), 3) AS avg_p_nn,
    round(avg(abs(p_final -
        CASE
            WHEN won THEN 1.0
            ELSE 0.0
        END::double precision)::numeric), 3) AS avg_error,
    round(avg(ml_edge::numeric), 3) AS avg_edge,
    count(
        CASE
            WHEN ood THEN 1
            ELSE NULL::integer
        END) AS n_ood,
    count(
        CASE
            WHEN ood_blocked THEN 1
            ELSE NULL::integer
        END) AS n_blocked
   FROM ml_decisions
  WHERE won IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ml_action
  ORDER BY ml_action;

SELECT menu_id,
    candidate_id,
    generated_rank,
    watchlist_rank,
    surfaced,
    selected_primary,
    control_role,
    index_key,
    expiry,
    strategy_family,
    lane,
    lot_size,
    control_eligible,
    content_canonical::jsonb -> 'legs'::text AS legs,
    content_canonical::jsonb -> 'margin_evidence'::text AS margin_evidence,
    content_canonical::jsonb AS content,
    content_sha256,
    created_at
   FROM ml_paper_decision_menu_candidates c;
